_non vestrum est scire iudicium_. The genitive _vestrum_ constructed with _esse_ indicates a relationship of possession; accordingly: “Is it not your part to know the judgment (concerning you)?; Kommt es euch nicht zu, das Urteil (über euch) zu kennen?” – Plater/White, p. 93. Micah 5:3 (Vg 5:4). Jerome’s translation: “And he will stand and shepherd in the strength of the Lord, in the magnanimity (_in sublimitate_) of the name of the Lord, and they will convert, because now he will be magnified as far as the end of the earth.” Jerome takes this to be a messianic passage. – Riemer Roukema: _Micah in Ancient Christianity. Reception and Interpretation_. Berlin 2019 (xv, 283 pp.), p. 139. Nahum (Naum) Secondary literature
